title: SDK: overload error typing + safe retry/backoff helper (Retry-After aware)
author: Monica Patel
release_notes: TypeScript SDK now exposes structured overload errors (Redwood error codes + Retry-After parsing) and includes a helper to implement safe exponential backoff with jitter. No API surface removals; new exports added under errors/retry utilities.
description: Context: As part of the Hosted circuit breakers + load shedding rollout, the API now returns consistent overload semantics (429/503) with Redwood-specific error codes and Retry-After guidance. This PR updates the TypeScript SDK to (1) type and surface overload errors in a stable way across REST + OpenAI-compatible endpoints; (2) provide a small helper for safe client retries that avoids retry storms and respects server hints. Customer reports in SUP-3974 and SUP-3961 show clients currently interpret mixed 5xx/429 responses inconsistently and often retry without jitter; this change makes the correct behavior easy and the unsafe behavior harder. Changes: Adds RedwoodOverloadErrorCode enum aligned to the shared API schema; introduces RedwoodOverloadError type that captures status, code, message, requestId, and parsed Retry-After (seconds + absolute date if provided); maps OpenAI-compat error bodies into the same error shape without breaking existing OpenAIError typing; exports shouldRetry(err) and getRetryDelayMs(err, attempt, opts) utilities (exponential backoff with full jitter, caps, and Retry-After precedence); ensures the helper returns false for non-idempotent requests by default unless caller opts in; documents recommended usage and adds examples. Notes: Retry guidance follows platform policy: prefer Retry-After when present; otherwise backoff with jitter; cap max delay; stop retrying on deterministic errors (auth, validation, quota) and on overload codes that indicate "do not retry". This is intentionally minimal and does not implement automatic retries in the SDK transport layer to avoid surprising behavior; it’s opt-in via helper functions. Testing: Adds unit tests for header parsing, error mapping for both endpoint modes, and deterministic jitter seeding in tests; adds integration-style test with mocked fetch returning 503 + Retry-After. Rollout: Patch release after merge; docs update in README plus changelog entry. References: ENG-4836, ENG-4823; aligns with the overload error taxonomy and header behavior agreed with SRE/Product.
commits: sdk/errors: add overload error codes + typed error object
sdk/http: parse Retry-After header (seconds + http-date) and plumb to errors
sdk/openai-compat: map overload responses into RedwoodOverloadError without breaking OpenAIError
sdk/retry: add shouldRetry + getRetryDelayMs with jitter/caps + tests
docs: add retry guidance snippet + overload error examples
notable_snippet: export type RedwoodOverloadError = { name: 'RedwoodOverloadError'; status: number; code: RedwoodOverloadErrorCode; message: string; requestId?: string; retryAfterSeconds?: number; retryAfterDate?: string; }; export function shouldRetry(err: unknown, opts?: { idempotent?: boolean }): boolean; export function getRetryDelayMs(err: unknown, attempt: number, opts?: { baseMs?: number; maxMs?: number; respectRetryAfter?: boolean }): number | null;
checklist: Added/updated public types and validated exports
Unit tests cover Retry-After parsing and jitter/backoff behavior
Docs updated with recommended retry usage
No automatic transport retries introduced (opt-in helper only)
Verified OpenAI-compat error mapping does not change existing error shape for non-overload errors
review_conversation: Brian Murphy: Can we ensure the overload codes match the shared schema exactly (casing + names)? We need this to align with gateway mapping.

Monica Patel: Yep. Pulled directly from the enum list in the schema doc and added a test that asserts the string union matches the exported list; also added a comment that these are wire values and should not be renamed.
Amara Diallo: Please make sure Retry-After http-date parsing is robust (we’ve seen both seconds and dates). Also: do we treat missing Retry-After as retryable?

Monica Patel: Added support for both formats. If Retry-After is missing, shouldRetry() can return true for overload statuses/codes, but getRetryDelayMs() falls back to exp backoff with jitter (base 250ms, capped 30s by default).
Henry Cho: Product ask: do not encourage infinite retries. Can the helper make it obvious to cap attempts and respect server hint?
Monica Patel: Added README example with maxAttempts and explicit stop condition; helper returns null delay for non-retryable errors so callers can break cleanly; also respects Retry-After by default.
Ibrahim Khan: One concern: shouldRetry defaults to idempotent=false. Most generation requests are not strictly idempotent. Is that too strict?

Monica Patel: Defaulting to conservative avoids retry storms and duplicate side effects; README calls out that callers can pass { idempotent: true } when they’ve implemented dedupe (e.g., request_id) or are retrying safe operations. Happy to revisit but SRE preference was conservative by default.
Ibrahim Khan: Request change: please seed jitter deterministically in tests. Current tests might flake.
Monica Patel: Done. Added injectRandom() only for tests (not exported) and used a fixed PRNG in vitest.
Brian Murphy: LGTM after the enum casing fix and adding requestId plumb-through.
Monica Patel: Added requestId extraction from headers where present (x-redwood-request-id) and from OpenAI-compat error.request_id when available.
final_status_summary: Merged after addressing reviewer requests on enum wire-value stability, deterministic jitter testing, and requestId propagation. Patch release queued for next SDK publish.
